title: Running Your First Python File Quiz
description: Check your understanding of Python files and running code.

questions.question: Which file extension is commonly used for Python files?
questions.explanation: Python source files commonly use the .py extension.

questions.question: A student installed Python on Windows but forgot to check Add Python to PATH. What may happen when they run python hello.py in Command Prompt?

options.text: The program still runs because VS Code fixes the issue automatically
The system may show: 'python' is not recognized as an internal or external command
The hello.py file is automatically deleted
Python runs but print() stops working

questions.explanation: If Python is not added to PATH, the terminal may not recognize the python command.
